summary:
Held 0 of today's 10 biggest UK/EU movers.

• 6 upside misses — MT.AS +6%, REN.AS +5%, REL.L +5%, ANTO.L +5%, WKL.AS +4%. These cleared the universe screen but no strategy picked them up; the morning brief either filtered them on a catalyst/RSI/earnings rule or had nothing positive to trigger an entry.

• 4 downside moves (DTE.DE -8%, AAF.L -6%, VOD.L -5%, STMPA.PA -3%) are unreachable on a long-only basket — no mechanism to express a short or pair-trade.

• Most instructive miss: DTE.DE (-7.94%) — No obvious news catalyst found. Searches returned no Oct-12-2026 reports on Deutsche Telekom, so the -7.94% move is unexplained and could be a sector or T-Mobile US-related move. Why we passed: Outside any active strategy's universe: DTE.DE is a large-cap German telecom (DAX, defensive sector) that no strategy includes. A -7.9% drop on a low-volatility utility-like name also looks like a long-only bot's falling knife.
